attrName: an attribute name is expected here — a name is letters, digits, `_` or `-`, optionally led by `@` or `:`
attrUnquoted: an attribute value is not quoted — write `name="value"`
elseIfOrphan: this `v-else-if` follows no `v-if` — the two must be siblings, with nothing between them
elseOrphan: this `v-else` follows no `v-if` — the two must be siblings, with nothing between them
expected: a `.vyx` file is expected to hold {token} here
interpEmpty: an interpolation is empty — `'{{ }}'` needs an expression between the braces
interpUnclosed: an interpolation is not closed — `'{{'` needs a matching `'}}'`
manyRoots: this component's `<template>` holds more than one root element — wrap them in one element
noElement: this component's `<template>` holds no element — a component's view is exactly one root element
noTag: a `<` starts no tag — a tag name follows it immediately
noTemplate: this component has no `<template>` section — a component's view is the one element inside it
scriptUnclosed: the `<script>` section is never closed — an unterminated string or `/* … */` comment swallows the closing `</script>`
strayClose: `</{tag}>` closes no element — the text after it would be lost
tagMismatch: `<{tag}>` is closed by `</{close}>` — a tag closes under its own name
tagUnclosed: a tag is not closed — the `<` opened here has no matching `>`
templateUnclosed: the `<template>` section is never closed — an unterminated comment or unclosed element swallows the closing `</template>`
vforEmpty: a `v-for` header reads `item in items`, and this one leaves one of the two empty
vforNoIn: a `v-for` header reads `item in items`, and this one has no `in`
vforNoKey: this `v-for` has no `:key` — the host differ reuses a row by its key, so give one that is stable per item
vforRunsIn: a `v-for` header reads `item in items`, and this one runs `in` into the next word
